}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== The PoE HAT is optional and required for PoE support.
{{See also|List of Single-board computers}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: ''[[Rockchip]]'' RK3308 @1.3GHz :Quad-core ([[ARM]] Cortex-A35) *Memory: 512MB (SDRAM) DDR3 *Storage: 8GB eMMC, TF card (max.64GB)/MMC card *WiFi & BT: , Bluetooth 5.2/BLE *Network: 1x Fast Ethernet w/ PoE (opt.) *USB: 1x USB 2.0 port *GPIO: 2x 26-pin Headers *Power Source: 5V/2A via USB Type-C
